_comment: English string catalog — the CANONICAL key set (litclock-dev#532 Stage 3). Every other language's catalog is CI-diffed against these keys. Whole sentences with {named} slots only: never fragments, never in-code grammar (scope-audit item 11). Plural keys end in a CLDR category suffix (.one/.other for English; a language's own categories come from its registry plural_forms).

system.title: System
system.action.restart.title: Restart
system.action.restart.consequence: Display blanks for about 30 seconds, then your quote returns.
system.action.poweroff.title: Power off
system.action.poweroff.consequence: Requires unplug + re-plug to start back up.
system.action.wifi_reset.title: Reset WiFi
system.action.wifi_reset.consequence: Forgets your saved WiFi networks so you can connect to a different one. Your other settings (location, weather, gift mode) stay saved.
system.action.factory_reset.title: Factory reset
system.action.factory_reset.consequence: Erases {b}everything{/b} — all settings, your WiFi, and the setup network’s password — and powers off. Power it on again to set it up fresh; the setup network will have a {b}new{/b} password, shown on the clock’s screen. Use this before you move or pass the clock on.
system.action.gift.title: Prepare for Gifting
system.action.gift.consequence: Type a welcome message for the recipient, then prepare the clock for shipping. We'll paint your message on the screen, wipe your WiFi, and power off. Plug it back in to test, or pack and ship it.
system.gift.label: Welcome message (optional)
system.gift.help: Up to 80 bytes across 1–2 lines (about 80 plain letters; emoji and accented characters count for more). Leave blank to use the default welcome. Backticks and {code}${/code} aren't allowed.
system.sheet.reboot.title: Restart LitClock?
system.sheet.reboot.body: The display will go blank for about 30 seconds, then your quote will return.
system.sheet.poweroff.title: Power off LitClock?
system.sheet.poweroff.body: Once it's off, you'll need to {b}unplug and re-plug{/b} the power cable to start it again. There's no remote on switch.
system.sheet.wifi_reset.title: Reset WiFi?
system.sheet.wifi_reset.body: {b}Only your WiFi{/b} will be cleared. Your location, weather, and gift settings stay saved. You’ll join the {b}{network}{/b} network from your phone’s WiFi list to enter new WiFi.
system.sheet.factory_reset.title: Factory reset?
system.sheet.factory_reset.body: {b}Everything{/b} will be erased — all settings, your WiFi, and the setup network’s password — and the clock powers off. This can’t be undone. Power it on again to set it up fresh, joining {b}{network}{/b} from your phone’s WiFi list. {b}Its password will be new{/b}, so if your phone saved the old one, tell it to forget {b}{network}{/b} first. The new password is on the clock’s screen.
system.sheet.gift.title: Prepare for Gifting?
system.sheet.gift.body: Your WiFi will be wiped and the clock will power off. The screen will show your welcome message until the recipient completes setup. Plug it back in to test, or pack and ship it.
